main_text.l: Atqui, inquit, hoc videtur aperte sequi
posteros pertinet: Ergo spurii in novo
in angulo, ergo Cæsar vicit Pom-
sunt obnoxii, sunt baptizandi, quia in
mortuus esset, dixit David servis suis, ego

l.i: sum abiturus ad ipsum, & ipse non est

page.notes: Catchword "reversu-" appears at the foot right as the line continues; treated as the last printed line. Page is in mixed roman and italic type; Latin ligatures rendered plainly. The word "illegitimè" and "Lepidus" are as printed.
